overview_description.description: Solidus AI Tech provide access to artiﬁcial intelligence services to governmental authorities, megacorps, SME’s and professionals. It has constructed an environmentally friendly 8,000-square-foot high-performance computing (HPC) Data Centre in a highly secure European location. They are launching the world's first deflationary Artificial Intelligence token (AITECH), which will be used as a payment gateway to license AIaaS, Blockchain-as-a-Service (BaaS), and rent HPC power through their Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) platform.
